2_biomes.summary: The biome is a GLOBAL ROTATING WORLD STATE, not a place: timer type sp3 71 (atl4 32) {b: phase, d: ms left} switches the whole map every 480 s (phase 0 = plain/forest lasts 960 s): 1 snow -> 2 dark -> 3 desert -> 4 sea -> 5 volcanic -> 0 plain -> 1 ... (full cycle 3360 s). At the switch the server sends, in the same frame as the timer, creates for the new-biome resource objects in view (new ids, new positions; their first move carries 7 = 255, the pop-in), a destroy record {7: 0, 10: 1} for every old-biome object in view, kills old-biome creatures in view (move {7: 18 dying, 9: 0, 10: 400 or 900}), and 0..0.7 s later removes the old objects. Biome music (winterN/darknessN/desertN/seaN/volcanicN/forestN.mp3) is fetched at the same instant. The same 2000x2000 cells show snow, then dark, then desert, then sea objects as the phases pass (grid below), so Ion did not walk between biomes: the world changed around him.

boss_markers.note: leaderboard message (atl4 64) carries ob = [minimap x, minimap y, boss kind] and pa = [x, y] (a second fixed marker, changed once at 1783.7 s); ob changed 8 times, independent of the phase switches (a boss spawns, dies or moves); kind is an index not yet mapped to a creature

2_biomes.boundaries: no spatial biome boundaries: all natural objects created inside one phase carry the phase prefix except a few minority prefixes listed per phase (left-over objects removed a frame later, or the fixed sea/plain set listed in minority bbox). Map clamp for the player is 350..17250 (sp3_facts map_edge).
2_biomes.implemented: no: world_atl4.json is a fixed snow world (115 objects) and the timer (atl4 32 b=1) is replayed once with a static value; no phase rotation, no object swap

resources.how_it_works: resources have an hp byte (move 7, 255 = full) that drops per hit (step depends on family and tool, table below; tree mode 16 => ~16 hits); at 0 the server sends {7: 0, 10: 1} (destroy animation, wood-destroy/stone-destroy.mp3), then remove. Respawn: see same_spot_create (a later create of the same family within 30 units, new id).

object_create_fields.11: 1 on a freshly (re)spawned gift; the same frame carries move 7=255 (spawn pop-in)
object_create_fields.15: owner clan id (476..483, matches clan list ids)

effects.note: category 2 creates carry only position, angle and 7=9; rows 28522..39892 (t 1703.62..2394.7 s), the same time as cannon/bow audio (turret and bow use)

3_entities.implemented: partial: static objects from a fixed snow list (world_atl4.json), 3 animal kinds (game_config animals: kind 2/10/66 templates), players; no projectiles (cat 4), no effects (cat 2), no gifts behaviour, no biome sets

Old names (Rock Fairy, Ice Golem, ...) were the client table names of the field-22 value and are wrong. See mimic/hosted/creatures.js SPECIES / SOURCES.identity.

4_chests.what: Chests are the gift<N> static objects (names.json 216..313; seen: gift24, gift26, gift27, gift29, gift46, gift47, gift48, gift49, gift50, gift51, gift52, gift53, gift68, gift86). They stand in the world like resources, are hit with any tool, lose a 0..255 hp byte per hit, and pop open at 0.
how_it_works: hit: client attack op (sp3 10 / atl4 4) with the gift in reach -> server move record on the gift {7: hp byte, 8: hit angle 0..255, 9: 1}; hp byte goes 255 -> 196 -> 137 -> 78 -> 20 -> 0 with the usual tools (step 59, five hits; a stronger hit took 129, first values [(102, 1), (106, 1), (128, 2), (137, 2), (157, 1), (196, 2)]).
each non-final hit also pays a small gather yield like a bush (own inventory +5 food and +5 XP for gift52, or stone/gold for others; see hit_inventory_deltas).

open: the hit that reaches 0 carries {7: 0, 10: 1}. To the opener only, in the same frame: type sp3 3 / atl4 75 {gi: N of giftN, i: 2 when a slot-4 bonus is paid} + inventory (atl4 53) with the loot + XP (atl4 27). Then 0..2 frames of move records with 10: 1 (and for gift68 position deltas: the box flies off), then remove (atl4 87).

loot seen (inventory delta in the open frame): gift52 -> {'0': 205} xp 5; gift49 -> {'2': 205} xp 5; gift49 -> {'2': 200} xp None; gift68 -> {'4': 2} xp None; gift86 -> {'2': 17, '3': 17, '4': 2} xp 34; gift48 -> {'0': 216} xp 16

spawn: a new gift appears with create field 11 = 1 plus a move with 7 = 255 in the same frame (pop-in animation); opened gifts do not come back at the same spot within the session (new ids appear elsewhere).
client audio: pumpkin-open.mp3 / chest-open.mp3 and pumpkin-destroy*.mp3 are fetched at the open frames (rows near 4287, 22951).
4_chests.evidence_ok: yes (6 opens by us with loot; hp steps, spawn flag); loot tables per gift number only partly (one sample per gift kind)
4_chests.implemented: no: gifts in world_atl4.json are inert static objects (resourceOf(gift) gives 1 food via gather_slot.gift, no hp, no open, no type 75, no respawn)

select.how_it_works: client sends select op with the item id; the next own move record carries 8 = id (0 = hand). Food/structure items are consumed or placed by the next attack op; tools change walk speed (sp3_facts walk.item_speed_factor_vs_hand).

unlock_craft.how_it_works: client picks an item (age-up item choice / upgrade). Server answers with item_count (atl4 36) B = [id*256 + 0] (item now owned, 0 placed), an inventory update when the item costs resources (Golden Axe: wood and stone drop), and for tools an own record 8 = id (auto-equip).

item_count_msgs.note: B = [item*256 + n]: n = number of that structure currently placed (counts up per placement, down when one is destroyed); 0 right after an unlock

eaten.item_basis: last select op before the heal record
eaten.how_it_works: select food, attack op -> own record {11: healed amount, 12: hp, 15: 350 anim ms}, inventory food cost paid (sp3_facts hp.food_instant_heal)

own_pet.how_it_works: at join the server creates the player's pet as a category-0 entity with id = own id + 1 and 13 = owner id; own_info (atl4 59) i = pet id. The pet follows, fights (7 = 34, its targets lose hp bar 9 and take 10/11) and takes damage (pet 9 = its hp bar, 10 = damage).

pet_commands.tx: JSON {type: sp3 14 (atl4 48), I: pet id, S: mode}
pet_commands.note: S 0..4 = pet behaviour mode buttons; replies are only pet state changes (7 = 34 after S 4/1, 2 = walk after S 2), no ack message

taming.note: one sample: JSON {type 18, _: creature id} on a wild Ice Golem in view -> the creature gets a move record {12: 1} (taming in progress) -> ~5 s later remove + create of the SAME id as a pet (13 = owner id, 16 = owner clan id, 17 = 0); pet commands then target it. What the player must hold or pay (inventory_delta_1_5s mixes gathering) and the success chance are not shown; tame_success/tame_fail.mp3 are only preloaded at page load.

6_animals.behaviour: wild creatures wander at 6-7 units/frame (sp3_facts creatures), switch to 7 = 34 (attack) when a player is near, deal 3..20 damage per hit to the player; hp is a 0..255 bar (field 9), never absolute

6_animals.implemented: partial: world.js World.animals wander + hurtAnimal (hp bar 9, kill XP guess); no aggression/attacks on players, no pets, no pet commands, no taming, only 3 kinds
6_animals.identity_note: the per-name keys in this section are field-22 TYPES with wrong names (see 3_entities creature_identity_note): Rock Fairy = Ice, Skunk = Spectrum, Yellow Scorpion = Poison, Ice Golem = Water, Snow Wolf = Plant, Polar Bear = Insect, Dragon = Fire, Dragon Fairy = Combat, Armadillo = Rock, Rabbid = Normal, Oryx = Electric, Plant Mask = boss type 73

how_it_works: place: select a structure (op 6) then attack op -> server create (atl4 79) cat 3 with 13 = def, 15 = clan id of the owner, 16 = owner id, 5 = angle; plus placed_list (sp3 85 / atl4 81) {o: [[id, x/58, y/58, def name]], p: total placed} and item_count (atl4 36) B = [item*256 + placed count] and an inventory update (cost).
removal of an own structure (destroyed or limit replace): placed_list {o: [[id]]} and item_count with the lower count.
structures take hits like resources: move {7: hp byte, 8: angle, 9: 1}; at 0 {10: 1} then remove; amounts per hit by tool in steps below
turrets (stone/amethyst-turret): move field 9 alone = turret aim angle (40+29 records), and they fire projectiles (cat 4 with owner 10 = turret id, see 3_entities projectiles)
doors (wooden-door): field 9 alone toggles (open/close, open-door1/close-door1.mp3), only for the owner clan
spikes hurt players that touch them: own damage 3..5 per contact near amethyst/diamond/golden/stone spikes (sp3_facts hp damage_by_cause object:*)

decay.how_it_works: structures lose hp over time with no hit: periodic move records carrying only 7 (hp byte), e.g. own stone-spike 4976918 255 -> 243 -> 230 -> ... -> 6 -> {7: 0, 10: 1} at 544.25 s, then placed_list {o: [[4976918]]} and item_count down. Rates per def below (hp byte per second; s_to_zero = full decay time)

7_structures.evidence_ok: yes for placement, list/count messages, hits/destroy, decay, spike damage; turret damage numbers partial
7_structures.implemented: partial: Player.useItem places with cost/limit/item_count and World.hazards spike damage; no structure hp/destroy/decay, no placed_list (atl4 81), no doors, no turrets, no clan field 15

Keys outside chat with no tx are client-only UI (menus, map, zoom) or unbound

mouse.note: left button = attack op (sp3 10); blur makes the client send move-key value 5 (release all)

chat.how_it_works: JSON [{type: sp3 0 (atl4 39), msg, tm}] -> rx bubble {i: sender id, m, mt: 1} to everyone in view plus, for clan members, a clan log entry {m, tm: clan id, s, n: name, p: sender id}

how_it_works: JSON {type: sp3 9 (atl4 68), o: action, n: arg}; o 25 + n = create clan with name n -> rx m 23 {l, n, x: clan id}, m 28 member list [[name, id_score?, 1, 0, player id, 0]], m 40 [id, name] (new clan in list), own field 14 changes
o 45 = open the clan list -> rx m 28 member list / m 46 (empty list) / m 22 [clan names]
o 53 / o 12 / o 11 = other clan actions (no direct reply seen for 12/11/53 except own state)
o 32 + n = member action on member id (kick/promote) -> rx m 39 then m 28
m 36 every few seconds: [x, y, 0, x2, y2, member id] = clan member positions on the minimap
m 69 at join: full clan list [[id, name]]; m 64 = clan removed (id); m 33 = join request {n: player id, p}; m 60 = ?
server announcement (atl4 52) 'The clan [14] has captured the totem' (totem object, def 0 'totem')

leaderboard.note: atl4 64 every ~1 s with the chained-XOR board (sp3_facts leaderboard) plus ob/pa minimap markers

quests.how_it_works: type sp3 74 (atl4 37) {o: quest 1..4, n: completion count}; quest 1 completes 3 times, 2/3/4 once per life; arrives together with XP and inventory gains (quest rewards?)
